meta.name: establish-administrative-counties
meta.description: Use when organizing conquered or acquired territories into centrally-administered counties (县). Covers territory assessment, settlement consolidation, official appointment, and administrative standardization. Based on Qin's 41-county system under Shang Yang.

copy.tagline: 将征服领土组织为行政县
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理征服或获得的领土并建立行政体系。
copy.tagline_en: Organize conquered territories into administrative counties
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage conquered or acquired territories and establish an administrative system.

howto.what: Claude 会按照秦商鞅的 41 县制，帮你将被征服或获得的领土组织成中央管理的县，包括评估领土、合并定居点、任命官员、统一行政管理，并记录新县的创建。
howto.when: 当你需要将被征服或获得的领土改建成中央直辖的县时触发，例如在扩张领土后要求设立行政县。

say.text: 帮我建立行政县管理新征服的领土。
任命一个县令并确保他向中央汇报。

howto.what_en: Claude will help you organize conquered or acquired territories into centrally-administered counties following Qin's 41-county system, including territorial assessment, settlement consolidation, official appointment, administrative standardization, and documentation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to reorganize conquered or acquired territories into centrally-administered counties, such as after expanding territory and requesting county establishment.

say_en.text: Help me establish administrative counties for newly conquered territory.
How do I consolidate villages into a county?
Appoint a county administrator who reports to the central government.
